local C = {}
C.__index = C
function C.copy(values)
    local result = {}
    for value in pairs(values) do result[value] = true end
    return result
end
function C.keys(values)
    local result = {}
    for value in pairs(values) do result[#result + 1] = value end
    table.sort(result)
    return result
end
function C.count(values) local n = 0; for _ in pairs(values) do n = n + 1 end; return n end
function C.equal(a, b)
    for value in pairs(a) do if not b[value] then return false end end
    for value in pairs(b) do if not a[value] then return false end end
    return true
end
function C.union(a, b) for value in pairs(b) do a[value] = true end; return a end
function C.intersect(a, b) for value in pairs(a) do if not b[value] then a[value] = nil end end; return a end
function C.new(fn)
    local result = setmetatable({ fn = fn, blocks = {}, instructions = {}, positions = {}, block_of = {}, reachable = {}, postorder = {},
        reverse_postorder = {}, reachable_predecessors = {}, dominators = {}, immediate = {}, loops = {}, depth = {} }, C)
    result:split(); result:connect(); result:dfs(); result:dominance(); result:natural_loops()
    return result
end
function C:split()
    local pending, first_label, current, previous = {}, nil, nil, nil
    for position, line in ipairs(self.fn.code) do
        if type(line) == "string" then
            if #pending == 0 then first_label = position end
            pending[#pending + 1] = line
        else
            local number = #self.instructions + 1
            if not current or #pending > 0 or previous == "goto" or previous == "if" or previous == "return" then
                local start = #pending > 0 and first_label or position
                if current then current.finish = start - 1 end
                current = { number = #self.blocks + 1, labels = pending, start = start, instructions = {}, predecessors = {}, successors = {} }
                self.blocks[#self.blocks + 1], pending = current, {}
            end
            self.instructions[number], self.positions[number], self.block_of[number] = line, position, current.number
            current.instructions[#current.instructions + 1], previous = number, line.kind
        end
    end
    current.finish = #self.fn.code
end
function C:connect()
    local labels = {}
    for number, block in ipairs(self.blocks) do for _, label in ipairs(block.labels) do labels[label] = number end end
    for number, block in ipairs(self.blocks) do
        local last = self.instructions[block.instructions[#block.instructions]]
        if last.kind == "goto" then block.successors = { labels[last.name] }
        elseif last.kind == "if" then
            block.successors = { number + 1 }
            if labels[last.name] ~= number + 1 then block.successors[2] = labels[last.name] end
        elseif last.kind ~= "return" then block.successors = { number + 1 } end
        for _, successor in ipairs(block.successors) do
            local predecessors = self.blocks[successor].predecessors
            predecessors[#predecessors + 1] = number
        end
    end
end
function C:dfs()
    local stack = { { 1, 1 } }
    self.reachable[1] = true
    while #stack > 0 do
        local top = stack[#stack]
        local successor = self.blocks[top[1]].successors[top[2]]
        if successor then
            top[2] = top[2] + 1
            if not self.reachable[successor] then self.reachable[successor] = true; stack[#stack + 1] = { successor, 1 } end
        else self.postorder[#self.postorder + 1] = top[1]; table.remove(stack) end
    end
    for i = #self.postorder, 1, -1 do self.reverse_postorder[#self.reverse_postorder + 1] = self.postorder[i] end
    for number in pairs(self.reachable) do
        local values = {}
        for _, predecessor in ipairs(self.blocks[number].predecessors) do if self.reachable[predecessor] then values[#values + 1] = predecessor end end
        self.reachable_predecessors[number] = values
    end
end
function C:dominance()
    for number in pairs(self.reachable) do self.dominators[number] = C.copy(self.reachable) end
    self.dominators[1] = { [1] = true }
    local changed = true
    while changed do
        changed = false
        for i = 2, #self.reverse_postorder do
            local number = self.reverse_postorder[i]
            local predecessors = self.reachable_predecessors[number]
            local values = C.copy(self.dominators[predecessors[1]])
            for j = 2, #predecessors do C.intersect(values, self.dominators[predecessors[j]]) end
            values[number] = true
            if not C.equal(values, self.dominators[number]) then self.dominators[number], changed = values, true end
        end
    end
    for number in pairs(self.reachable) do
        if number ~= 1 then
            local parent, largest = nil, -1
            for candidate in pairs(self.dominators[number]) do
                local size = C.count(self.dominators[candidate])
                if candidate ~= number and size > largest then parent, largest = candidate, size end
            end
            self.immediate[number] = parent
        end
    end
end
function C:natural_loops()
    for _, header in ipairs(C.keys(self.reachable)) do
        local latches, members, pending = {}, { [header] = true }, {}
        for _, number in ipairs(self.reachable_predecessors[header]) do
            if self.dominators[number][header] then
                latches[#latches + 1], members[number] = number, true
                if number ~= header then pending[#pending + 1] = number end
            end
        end
        if #latches > 0 then
            while #pending > 0 do
                local number = table.remove(pending)
                for _, predecessor in ipairs(self.reachable_predecessors[number]) do
                    if not members[predecessor] then members[predecessor] = true; pending[#pending + 1] = predecessor end
                end
            end
            self.loops[#self.loops + 1] = { header = header, latches = latches, blocks = members, exits = {}, outside = {}, depth = 0 }
        end
    end
    for number in ipairs(self.blocks) do
        self.depth[number] = 0
        for _, loop in ipairs(self.loops) do if loop.blocks[number] then self.depth[number] = self.depth[number] + 1 end end
    end
    for _, loop in ipairs(self.loops) do
        for _, other in ipairs(self.loops) do if other.blocks[loop.header] then loop.depth = loop.depth + 1 end end
        for number in pairs(loop.blocks) do
            local block = self.blocks[number]
            if self.instructions[block.instructions[#block.instructions]].kind == "return" then loop.exits[number] = true end
            for _, successor in ipairs(block.successors) do
                if not loop.blocks[successor] then loop.exits[number], loop.outside[successor] = true, true end
            end
        end
    end
end
return C

local P = require("tac_parser")
local C = require("cfg")
local D = {}
D.__index = D
function D.reaching_transfer(instruction, number, state)
    local result = C.copy(state)
    if instruction.destination then
        local prefix = instruction.destination .. ":"
        for definition in pairs(result) do if definition:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then result[definition] = nil end end
        result[prefix .. number] = true
    end
    return result
end
function D.live_transfer(instruction, state)
    local result = C.copy(state)
    if instruction.destination then result[instruction.destination] = nil end
    for _, variable in ipairs(P.used(instruction)) do result[variable] = true end
    return result
end
function D:expression_transfer(instruction, _, state)
    local result = C.copy(state)
    local expression = P.expression(instruction)
    if expression then result[expression] = true end
    for key in pairs(result) do
        local value = self.expressions[key]
        if instruction.kind == "store" and value.kind == "load" and instruction.name == value.name
            or instruction.kind == "call" and value.kind == "load"
            or instruction.destination and (value.a == instruction.destination or value.kind == "bin" and value.b == instruction.destination) then
            result[key] = nil
        end
    end
    return result
end
function D.copy_transfer(instruction, _, state)
    local result = C.copy(state)
    if instruction.destination then
        for key in pairs(result) do
            local first, second = key:match("^([^:]+):(.+)$")
            if first == instruction.destination or second == instruction.destination then result[key] = nil end
        end
    end
    if instruction.kind == "copy" and type(instruction.a) == "string" and instruction.a ~= instruction.destination then
        result[instruction.destination .. ":" .. instruction.a] = true
    end
    return result
end
function D.new(graph)
    local result = setmetatable({ graph = graph, expressions = {}, iterations = {}, live_before = {}, live_after = {} }, D)
    local expressions, copies = {}, {}
    for number, instruction in ipairs(graph.instructions) do
        if graph.reachable[graph.block_of[number]] then
            local expression = P.expression(instruction)
            if expression then expressions[expression], result.expressions[expression] = true, instruction end
            if instruction.kind == "copy" and type(instruction.a) == "string" and instruction.a ~= instruction.destination then
                copies[instruction.destination .. ":" .. instruction.a] = true
            end
        end
    end
    local expression_transfer = function(instruction, number, state) return result:expression_transfer(instruction, number, state) end
    result.reaching_in, result.reaching_out = result:forward("reaching", D.reaching_transfer, {})
    result.live_in, result.live_out = result:liveness()
    result.expression_in, result.expression_out = result:forward("expressions", expression_transfer, expressions)
    result.copy_in, result.copy_out = result:forward("copies", D.copy_transfer, copies)
    result.reaching_before = result:boundaries(result.reaching_in, D.reaching_transfer)
    result.expression_before = result:boundaries(result.expression_in, expression_transfer)
    result.copy_before = result:boundaries(result.copy_in, D.copy_transfer)
    for _, block_number in ipairs(C.keys(graph.reachable)) do
        local state, block = C.copy(result.live_out[block_number]), graph.blocks[block_number]
        for i = #block.instructions, 1, -1 do
            local number = block.instructions[i]
            result.live_after[number] = C.copy(state)
            state = D.live_transfer(graph.instructions[number], state)
            result.live_before[number] = C.copy(state)
        end
    end
    return result
end
function D:forward(kind, transfer, universe)
    local graph, incoming, outgoing, iterations = self.graph, {}, {}, 0
    for number in pairs(graph.reachable) do outgoing[number] = C.copy(universe) end
    while true do
        local changed = false
        iterations = iterations + 1
        for _, number in ipairs(graph.reverse_postorder) do
            local predecessors, state = graph.reachable_predecessors[number], {}
            if kind == "reaching" then
                for _, predecessor in ipairs(predecessors) do C.union(state, outgoing[predecessor]) end
                if number == 1 then for _, parameter in ipairs(graph.fn.parameters) do state[parameter .. ":0"] = true end end
            elseif number ~= 1 then
                state = C.copy(outgoing[predecessors[1]])
                for i = 2, #predecessors do C.intersect(state, outgoing[predecessors[i]]) end
            end
            incoming[number] = C.copy(state)
            for _, index in ipairs(graph.blocks[number].instructions) do state = transfer(graph.instructions[index], index, state) end
            if not C.equal(state, outgoing[number]) then outgoing[number], changed = state, true end
        end
        if not changed then self.iterations[kind] = iterations; return incoming, outgoing end
    end
end
function D:liveness()
    local graph, incoming, outgoing, iterations = self.graph, {}, {}, 0
    for number in pairs(graph.reachable) do incoming[number] = {} end
    while true do
        local changed = false
        iterations = iterations + 1
        for _, number in ipairs(graph.postorder) do
            local block, state = graph.blocks[number], {}
            for _, successor in ipairs(block.successors) do C.union(state, incoming[successor]) end
            outgoing[number] = C.copy(state)
            for i = #block.instructions, 1, -1 do state = D.live_transfer(graph.instructions[block.instructions[i]], state) end
            if not C.equal(state, incoming[number]) then incoming[number], changed = state, true end
        end
        if not changed then self.iterations.liveness = iterations; return incoming, outgoing end
    end
end
function D:boundaries(incoming, transfer)
    local result, graph = {}, self.graph
    for _, number in ipairs(C.keys(graph.reachable)) do
        local state = C.copy(incoming[number])
        for _, index in ipairs(graph.blocks[number].instructions) do
            result[index] = C.copy(state)
            state = transfer(graph.instructions[index], index, state)
        end
    end
    return result
end
return D

local P = require("tac_parser")
local C = require("cfg")
local D = require("dataflow")
local O = require("optimizations")
local R = require("regalloc")
local pass_order = { "constprop", "copyprop", "cse", "dce", "licm", "unreachable" }
local versions = { "original", "optimized", "allocated" }
local function append(result, values) for _, value in ipairs(values) do result[#result + 1] = value end end
local function list(values, prefix)
    if #values == 0 then return "-" end
    local result = {}
    for i, value in ipairs(values) do result[i] = (prefix or "") .. tostring(value) end
    return table.concat(result, ",")
end
local function reaching_numbers(flow, number, variable)
    local result, prefix = {}, variable .. ":"
    for key in pairs(flow.reaching_before[number]) do if key:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then result[tonumber(key:sub(#prefix + 1))] = true end end
    return result
end
local function inside_definitions(graph, loop, definitions)
    local result = {}
    for number in pairs(definitions) do if number ~= 0 and loop.blocks[graph.block_of[number]] then result[number] = true end end
    return result
end
local function constant_value(graph, definitions)
    if not next(definitions) or definitions[0] then return nil end
    local value
    for number in pairs(definitions) do
        local instruction = graph.instructions[number]
        if instruction.kind ~= "copy" or type(instruction.a) ~= "number" or value ~= nil and value ~= instruction.a then return nil end
        value = instruction.a
    end
    return value
end
local function propagation(fn, graph, flow, constants)
    local replacements, records = {}, {}
    for number, original in ipairs(graph.instructions) do
        if graph.reachable[graph.block_of[number]] then
            local instruction = P.copy(original)
            local available = {}
            if not constants then
                for pair in pairs(flow.copy_before[number]) do local a, b = pair:match("^([^:]+):(.+)$"); available[a] = b end
            end
            for _, field in ipairs(P.fields(original)) do
                local variable = original[field]
                if type(variable) == "string" then
                    local value
                    if constants then value = constant_value(graph, reaching_numbers(flow, number, variable)) else value = available[variable] end
                    if value ~= nil then
                        instruction[field] = value
                        records[#records + 1] = "#" .. number .. ": " .. variable .. " -> " .. tostring(value)
                    end
                end
            end
            if constants then
                local result = O.fold(instruction)
                if not result then records[#records + 1] = "#" .. number .. ": delete " .. P.string(instruction); replacements[number] = {}
                else
                    if result ~= instruction then records[#records + 1] = "#" .. number .. ": fold " .. P.string(result) end
                    replacements[number] = { result }
                end
            else replacements[number] = { instruction } end
        end
    end
    O.rewrite(fn, replacements)
    return #records, records
end
local function expression_sources(graph, expression, candidate)
    local block_number = graph.block_of[candidate]
    local block = graph.blocks[block_number]
    for i = #block.instructions, 1, -1 do
        local number = block.instructions[i]
        if number < candidate and P.expression(graph.instructions[number]) == expression then return { [number] = true } end
    end
    local sources, examined, pending = {}, {}, {}
    append(pending, graph.reachable_predecessors[block_number])
    while #pending > 0 do
        local number = table.remove(pending)
        if not examined[number] then
            examined[number] = true
            local found, instructions = false, graph.blocks[number].instructions
            for i = #instructions, 1, -1 do
                local index = instructions[i]
                if P.expression(graph.instructions[index]) == expression then sources[index], found = true, true; break end
            end
            if not found then append(pending, graph.reachable_predecessors[number]) end
        end
    end
    return sources
end
local function common_subexpressions(fn, graph, flow)
    local groups, by_expression = {}, {}
    for number, instruction in ipairs(graph.instructions) do
        if graph.reachable[graph.block_of[number]] then
            local expression = P.expression(instruction)
            if expression and flow.expression_before[number][expression] then
                if not by_expression[expression] then by_expression[expression] = {}; groups[#groups + 1] = expression end
                local numbers = by_expression[expression]
                numbers[#numbers + 1] = number
            end
        end
    end
    local replacements, records, changes = {}, {}, 0
    for _, expression in ipairs(groups) do
        local numbers, sources = by_expression[expression], {}
        for _, number in ipairs(numbers) do C.union(sources, expression_sources(graph, expression, number)) end
        for _, number in ipairs(numbers) do sources[number] = nil end
        local temporary, edits = O.cse(fn, graph, sources, numbers)
        for number, edit in pairs(edits) do replacements[number] = edit end
        records[#records + 1] = expression .. ": " .. temporary .. " sources=" .. list(C.keys(sources), "#") .. " replaced=" .. list(numbers, "#")
        changes = changes + #numbers
    end
    O.rewrite(fn, replacements)
    return changes, records
end
local function dead_code(fn, graph, flow)
    local replacements, records = {}, {}
    for _, block_number in ipairs(C.keys(graph.reachable)) do
        local state, block = C.copy(flow.live_out[block_number]), graph.blocks[block_number]
        for i = #block.instructions, 1, -1 do
            local number = block.instructions[i]
            local instruction = graph.instructions[number]
            local destination = instruction.destination
            if instruction.kind == "copy" and destination == instruction.a
                or (instruction.kind == "copy" or instruction.kind == "bin" or instruction.kind == "load") and not state[destination] then
                replacements[number], records[number] = {}, "#" .. number .. ": delete " .. P.string(instruction)
            else
                if instruction.kind == "call" and destination and not state[destination] then
                    records[number] = "#" .. number .. ": unused result " .. P.string(instruction)
                    instruction = P.copy(instruction)
                    instruction.destination, replacements[number] = nil, { instruction }
                end
                state = D.live_transfer(instruction, state)
            end
        end
    end
    O.rewrite(fn, replacements)
    local ordered = {}
    for _, number in ipairs(C.keys(records)) do ordered[#ordered + 1] = records[number] end
    return #ordered, ordered
end
local function invariant_moves(graph, flow, loop)
    local numbers, stores, calls, definitions = {}, {}, false, {}
    for block in pairs(loop.blocks) do append(numbers, graph.blocks[block].instructions) end
    table.sort(numbers)
    for _, number in ipairs(numbers) do
        local instruction = graph.instructions[number]
        if instruction.kind == "store" then stores[instruction.name] = true elseif instruction.kind == "call" then calls = true end
        if instruction.destination then definitions[instruction.destination] = (definitions[instruction.destination] or 0) + 1 end
    end
    local marked, order, changed = {}, {}, true
    while changed do
        changed = false
        for _, number in ipairs(numbers) do
            local instruction = graph.instructions[number]
            if not marked[number] and (instruction.kind == "copy" or instruction.kind == "bin" or instruction.kind == "load")
                and not (instruction.kind == "load" and (calls or stores[instruction.name])) then
                local valid = true
                for _, variable in ipairs(P.used(instruction)) do
                    local reaching = reaching_numbers(flow, number, variable)
                    local inside = inside_definitions(graph, loop, reaching)
                    if next(inside) and not (C.count(reaching) == 1 and marked[next(inside)]) then valid = false; break end
                end
                if valid then marked[number], changed = true, true; order[#order + 1] = number end
            end
        end
    end
    local moved, moves = {}, {}
    for _, number in ipairs(order) do
        local instruction = graph.instructions[number]
        local destination, block = instruction.destination, graph.block_of[number]
        local valid = definitions[destination] == 1 and not flow.live_in[loop.header][destination]
        local dominates, dead_outside = true, true
        for exit in pairs(loop.exits) do if not graph.dominators[exit][block] then dominates = false end end
        for outside in pairs(loop.outside) do if flow.live_in[outside][destination] then dead_outside = false end end
        local dangerous = instruction.kind == "load" or instruction.kind == "bin" and (instruction.operation == "/" or instruction.operation == "%")
            and (type(instruction.b) == "string" or instruction.b == 0)
        if not dominates and (dangerous or not dead_outside) then valid = false end
        if valid then
            for _, variable in ipairs(P.used(instruction)) do
                for definition in pairs(inside_definitions(graph, loop, reaching_numbers(flow, number, variable))) do if not moved[definition] then valid = false end end
            end
        end
        if valid then moved[number] = true; moves[#moves + 1] = number end
    end
    return moves
end
local function loop_motion(fn, graph, flow)
    local loops = {}
    append(loops, graph.loops)
    table.sort(loops, function(a, b)
        local ac, bc = C.count(a.blocks), C.count(b.blocks)
        return ac < bc or ac == bc and a.header < b.header
    end)
    for _, loop in ipairs(loops) do
        local moves = invariant_moves(graph, flow, loop)
        if #moves > 0 then
            local destination = O.hoist(fn, graph, loop, moves)
            return #moves, { "B" .. loop.header .. ": hoist " .. list(moves, "#") .. " to " .. destination }
        end
    end
    return 0, {}
end
local function unreachable(fn, graph)
    local blocks, jumps, labels = O.unreachable(fn, graph)
    local records = {}
    for _, number in ipairs(blocks) do records[#records + 1] = "remove block B" .. number end
    for _, number in ipairs(jumps) do records[#records + 1] = "remove jump #" .. number end
    for _, label in ipairs(labels) do records[#records + 1] = "remove label " .. label end
    return #records, records
end
local passes = {
    constprop = function(fn, graph, flow) return propagation(fn, graph, flow, true) end,
    copyprop = function(fn, graph, flow) return propagation(fn, graph, flow, false) end,
    cse = common_subexpressions, dce = dead_code, licm = loop_motion, unreachable = unreachable
}
local function instruction_count(fn)
    local result = 0
    for _, line in ipairs(fn.code) do if type(line) ~= "string" then result = result + 1 end end
    return result
end
local function optimize(fn, enabled, maximum_rounds, totals)
    local before, lines, rounds = instruction_count(fn), { "== " .. fn.name .. " ==" }, 0
    for round = 1, maximum_rounds do
        local counts, records, changed = {}, {}, false
        rounds = round
        for _, name in ipairs(enabled) do
            local graph = C.new(fn)
            local count, entries = passes[name](fn, graph, D.new(graph))
            totals[name] = (totals[name] or 0) + count
            counts[#counts + 1] = name .. "=" .. count
            if count > 0 then changed = true end
            for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do records[#records + 1] = "  " .. name .. " " .. entry end
        end
        lines[#lines + 1] = "round " .. round .. ": " .. table.concat(counts, " ")
        append(lines, records)
        if not changed then break end
    end
    lines[#lines + 1] = string.format("result: rounds=%d instructions=%d->%d", rounds, before, instruction_count(fn))
    return lines
end
local function call_graph(program, heading)
    local callees = {}
    for _, fn in ipairs(program.functions) do
        local called = {}
        for _, line in ipairs(fn.code) do if type(line) ~= "string" and line.kind == "call" then called[line.name] = true end end
        local values = {}
        for _, target in ipairs(program.functions) do if called[target.name] then values[#values + 1] = target.name end end
        callees[fn.name] = values
    end
    local function reachable(starts)
        local reached, pending = {}, {}
        append(pending, starts)
        while #pending > 0 do
            local name = table.remove(pending)
            if not reached[name] then reached[name] = true; append(pending, callees[name]) end
        end
        return reached
    end
    local reached, lines, missing = reachable({ "main" }), { "== call graph (" .. heading .. ") ==" }, {}
    for _, fn in ipairs(program.functions) do
        lines[#lines + 1] = fn.name .. " -> " .. list(callees[fn.name]) .. (reachable(callees[fn.name])[fn.name] and " (recursive)" or "")
        if not reached[fn.name] then missing[#missing + 1] = fn.name end
    end
    lines[#lines + 1] = "unreachable functions: " .. list(missing)
    return lines, reached
end
local function definition_list(values)
    local definitions = {}
    for key in pairs(values) do
        local variable, number = key:match("^([^:]+):(%d+)$")
        definitions[#definitions + 1] = { variable, tonumber(number) }
    end
    table.sort(definitions, function(a, b) return a[2] < b[2] or a[2] == b[2] and a[1] < b[1] end)
    local result = {}
    for _, definition in ipairs(definitions) do result[#result + 1] = definition[1] .. ":" .. definition[2] end
    return list(result)
end
local function function_analysis(fn, heading)
    local graph = C.new(fn)
    local flow, number = D.new(graph), 0
    local lines = { "== " .. fn.name .. " (" .. heading .. ") ==", "code:" }
    for _, line in ipairs(fn.code) do
        if type(line) == "string" then lines[#lines + 1] = line .. ":"
        else
            number = number + 1
            local text = "  #" .. number .. " " .. P.string(line)

        local smallest, preferred
        for color = 0, registers - 1 do if not occupied[color] then smallest = color; break end end
        if smallest == nil then result.spills[node] = true
        else
            for partner in pairs(result.partners[node]) do
                local color = result.colors[partner]
                if color ~= nil and not occupied[color] and (preferred == nil or color < preferred) then preferred = color end
            end
            result.colors[node] = preferred or smallest
        end
    end
    return result
end
return R

local P = {}
P.kinds = { "copy", "bin", "load", "store", "goto", "if", "param", "call", "return", "read", "print" }
function P.copy(value)
    local result = {}
    for key, item in pairs(value) do result[key] = item end
    return result
end
function P.function_copy(fn)
    local code = {}
    for i, line in ipairs(fn.code) do code[i] = line end
    return { name = fn.name, parameters = fn.parameters, code = code, temporary_serial = 0, preheader_serial = 0 }
end
function P.fields(instruction)
    local kind = instruction.kind
    if kind == "bin" or kind == "if" or kind == "store" then return { "a", "b" } end
    if kind == "copy" or kind == "load" or kind == "param" or kind == "print" or kind == "return" and instruction.a ~= nil then return { "a" } end
    return {}
end
function P.used(instruction)
    local result = {}
    for _, field in ipairs(P.fields(instruction)) do
        local value = instruction[field]
        if type(value) == "string" then result[#result + 1] = value end
    end
    return result
end
function P.expression(instruction)
    if instruction.kind == "bin" then return tostring(instruction.a) .. instruction.operation .. tostring(instruction.b)
    elseif instruction.kind == "load" then return instruction.name .. "[" .. tostring(instruction.a) .. "]" end
end
function P.calculate(operator, a, b)
    if operator == "+" then return a + b elseif operator == "-" then return a - b elseif operator == "*" then return a * b end
    if operator == "/" or operator == "%" then
        local quotient = math.abs(a) // math.abs(b)
        if (a < 0) ~= (b < 0) then quotient = -quotient end
        return operator == "/" and quotient or a - b * quotient
    end
    local result
    if operator == "<" then result = a < b elseif operator == "<=" then result = a <= b
    elseif operator == ">" then result = a > b elseif operator == ">=" then result = a >= b
    elseif operator == "==" then result = a == b else result = a ~= b end
    return result and 1 or 0
end
function P.string(instruction)
    local kind, a, b = instruction.kind, tostring(instruction.a), tostring(instruction.b)
    if kind == "copy" then return instruction.destination .. " = " .. a
    elseif kind == "bin" then return instruction.destination .. " = " .. a .. " " .. instruction.operation .. " " .. b
    elseif kind == "load" then return instruction.destination .. " = " .. instruction.name .. "[" .. a .. "]"
    elseif kind == "store" then return instruction.name .. "[" .. a .. "] = " .. b
    elseif kind == "goto" then return "goto " .. instruction.name
    elseif kind == "if" then return "if " .. a .. " " .. instruction.operation .. " " .. b .. " goto " .. instruction.name
    elseif kind == "call" then return (instruction.destination and instruction.destination .. " = " or "") .. "call " .. instruction.name .. " " .. instruction.count
    elseif kind == "read" then return "read " .. instruction.destination
    elseif kind == "return" and instruction.a == nil then return "return" end
    return kind .. " " .. a
end
function P.function_lines(fn)
    local result = { "func " .. fn.name .. (#fn.parameters > 0 and " " .. table.concat(fn.parameters, " ") or "") }
    for _, line in ipairs(fn.code) do result[#result + 1] = type(line) == "string" and line .. ":" or "    " .. P.string(line) end
    result[#result + 1] = "end"
    return result
end
function P.program_lines(program)
    local result = {}
    for _, array in ipairs(program.arrays) do result[#result + 1] = "array " .. array[1] .. " " .. array[2] end
    for _, fn in ipairs(program.functions) do
        if #result > 0 then result[#result + 1] = "" end
        for _, line in ipairs(P.function_lines(fn)) do result[#result + 1] = line end
    end
    return result
end
local function operand(word)
    local first = word:byte(1)
    return (first == 45 or first >= 48 and first <= 57) and assert(math.tointeger(tonumber(word))) or word
end
local function array(word)
    local name, index = word:match("^([^%[]+)%[(.*)%]$")
    return name, operand(index)
end
local function instruction(words)
    local first, value = words[1], {}
    if first == "goto" then value.kind, value.name = "goto", words[2]
    elseif first == "if" then value.kind, value.a, value.operation, value.b, value.name = "if", operand(words[2]), words[3], operand(words[4]), words[6]
    elseif first == "param" or first == "print" then value.kind, value.a = first, operand(words[2])
    elseif first == "return" then value.kind, value.a = first, words[2] and operand(words[2]) or nil
    elseif first == "read" then value.kind, value.destination = first, words[2]
    elseif first == "call" then value.kind, value.name, value.count = first, words[2], tonumber(words[3])
    elseif first:find("[", 1, true) then value.kind, value.name, value.a, value.b = "store", array(first); value.b = operand(words[3])
    elseif words[3] == "call" then value.kind, value.destination, value.name, value.count = "call", first, words[4], tonumber(words[5])
    elseif #words == 5 then value.kind, value.destination, value.a, value.operation, value.b = "bin", first, operand(words[3]), words[4], operand(words[5])
    elseif words[3]:find("[", 1, true) then value.kind, value.destination = "load", first; value.name, value.a = array(words[3])
    else value.kind, value.destination, value.a = "copy", first, operand(words[3]) end
    return value
end
function P.read(path)
    local result, current = { arrays = {}, functions = {} }
    for line in io.lines(path) do
        local words = {}
        for word in line:gmatch("[^ ]+") do words[#words + 1] = word end
        if #words > 0 and words[1]:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then
            if words[1] == "array" then result.arrays[#result.arrays + 1] = { words[2], tonumber(words[3]) }
            elseif words[1] == "func" then
                local parameters = {}
                for i = 3, #words do parameters[#parameters + 1] = words[i] end
                current = { name = words[2], parameters = parameters, code = {}, temporary_serial = 0, preheader_serial = 0 }
                result.functions[#result.functions + 1] = current
            elseif words[1] == "end" then current = nil
            elseif #words == 1 and words[1]:sub(-1) == ":" then current.code[#current.code + 1] = words[1]:sub(1, -2)
            else current.code[#current.code + 1] = instruction(words) end
        end
    end
    return result
end
return P
